purpose: Preserve the current TinyFish Cloudflare and Shopify read-only provider boundaries while documenting the standalone Founder Control Room and Chief AI peer authority contract, including exact candidate peer-head bindings that fail closed on drift without claiming shared runtime, transferred authority, merge, deploy, publication, provider mutation, or runtime activation.

claims: `wrangler.worker.toml` must list `TINYFISH_API_KEY` under `[secrets].required`, so canonical exact-main Deploy rejects missing provider-held TinyFish activation before Worker mutation while never copying the secret value through GitHub Actions.
`README.md` must keep TinyFish source and CI readiness separate from provider/runtime activation and state that canonical Deploy verifies only provider-held binding-name presence before promotion.
`README.md` must describe Shopify child-provider observation as source-only, non-authorizing evidence and must never relabel a matching snapshot as live provider authority or mutation permission.

`README.md` must describe Founder Control Room and Chief AI as independently callable standalone peers with separate identity, lifecycle, receipts, failure state, continuity markers, and authority boundaries; candidate PRs are evidence carriers rather than runtime dependencies.

`docs/CLOUDFLARE_REASONING.md` must treat `TINYFISH_API_KEY` as a provider-held Worker binding and require canonical Deploy to fail closed on a missing binding name without exposing or re-uploading its value.

`docs/deployment/CLOUDFLARE_WORKER_TARGETS.md` must name `TINYFISH_API_KEY` as a required canonical Worker secret while preserving live provider observation and real TinyFish Search/Fetch as separate activation proof.
`docs/SECRETS.md` must keep the TinyFish key in the Cloudflare Worker secret plane and never recast the provider-held value as a GitHub Actions secret or proof artifact.

`src/lib/providerObservation.ts` must classify child-provider evidence as current, undeclared, scope drift, identity drift, stale, or unknown without granting execution authority, and it must fail closed when observation freshness, completeness, declaration identity, or scope equality is not proven.

`src/providers/ShopifyReadOnlyProvider.ts` must bind Shopify observation to the exact Founder Control Room permanent and branded store identities, require complete pagination and app scope inventory, withhold CURRENT on incomplete or mismatched provider evidence, keep reconciliation non-authorizing, and never persist provider inventory or perform Shopify mutation.

`config/founder-chief-pair.contract.json` must keep Founder Control Room and Chief AI independently callable standalone peers, prohibit identity, receipt, failure, continuity, or authority collapse, and state that evidence never creates or transfers authority.

`.control-room/founder-chief-pair-peer-lock.json` must bind FCR PR #781 to the exact observed Chief pair and necessary-fix candidate head SHAs while remaining non-authorizing evidence that cannot grant merge, deployment, provider mutation, or runtime truth.

`scripts/verify-founder-chief-pair.mjs` must remain the load-bearing local and cross-repository pair-policy verifier; changes to it require current pair-authority documentation truth even when the shared JSON contract itself is unchanged.

`.github/workflows/founder-chief-pair-contract.yml` must resolve both live Chief pull requests from GitHub, require each provider head to equal the immutable FCR candidate peer lock, and fail closed before cross-repository verification when either peer head drifts.

`scripts/verify-documentation-truth.mjs` must classify the shared pair contract, FCR candidate peer lock, pair verifier, and pair workflow as pair-authority truth-sensitive surfaces and fail closed when the README, required truth docs, or current path-bound documentation receipt are missing.
